title: Tasty Lapis
description: Lets you eat Lapis Lazuli in nugget form. A thing that everyone has always wanted to do. Obviously. Also adds decorative Lapis Lazuli blocks.
body:
A mod that lets you eat Lapis Lazuli as nuggets. Y'know, cause everyone wants to do that, obviously. It also adds some decorative Lapis Lazuli blocks I guess, but let's be real, we both know why you're _really_ here...

![Cuprite eating Lapis Lazuli. As you do.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c892f906c5fa848a3d5f55fa5e92ed27cd44c06.png)

## New item:
- Lapis Lazuli Nugget

Is completely edible and very tasty, and will give you no negative effects whatsoever. :)

## New blocks:
- Smooth Lapis Lazuli Block
- Banded Lapis Lazuli Block
- Banded Lapis Lazuli Slab
- Chiseled Lapis Lazuli

##
(NOTE: I made this like a year ago as a joke for a modded server with some friends and forgot to ever upload it. So here we are. Lol)
